region_source.changes: Retains normalized slide region semantics, primary-pointer/whole-slide/percentage selection and explicit commit. Captures an owned native intrinsic-size slide using a bounded cropped PNG canvas and exact parent-origin/window/token messages. Temporary native handles, canvas and clone frames are explicitly released.

jot_source_adaptations.changes: Boot/probe includes a unique static-document instance. Parent binds it before byte transfer and rejects a replacement document after initialization. Token-scoped pagehide notification invalidates old ready/reference sessions through the existing close/manual reread path. Same-document duplicate probes remain valid. No automatic file transfer or upload retry.

Prior batch results/highlight are released, previous/next batches rescan bookmarks. Cooperative timers and stale-generation/close guards retain existing serial work timeout/cancel and capture ordering. Source/render limits remain.

Retains native1.2.4 node-bound highlight API and upstream active/normal colors. Current displayed slide scans all admitted text independently of1000-result navigation batches using4096-unit literal windows and cooperative yields. Identical native bounds share one overlay, active area stays above normal areas. Owned handles are disposed on query/render/slide/close and stale async completion. Serialized render-observer repaint covers search/manual navigation/zoom/resize. Region capture still uses independent native source rendering.

Native bootstrap source-byte admission aligns with Gateway and shared verified modern Office byte reader at32MiB. Existing container/XML/native renderer/workbook limits and fixed origin/window/token/instance/capture protocols remain. Larger structured sources up to100MiB get explicit visual source_limit. The shared byte verifier uses one preallocated receive buffer with exact length/SHA proof and independent stream cancellation.

Word keeps zoom/outline/scroll, PPTX keeps slide/zoom/thumbnails/scroll, XLSX keeps actual sheet/zoom/scroll through original native API commands and serialized renderer queue. Explicit quote focus suppresses older saved viewport restoration. Frame timers/scroll subscriptions are released on closure; reports coalesce scroll updates at160ms. Original library and renderer assets remain unchanged.
